The Cry3A (CryIIIA) delta-endotoxin C-terminal domain d1dlca1 (1dlc A:500-644, sunid 23719) was b.18.1.3: fold b.18 'Galactose-binding domain-like' (49784), superfamily b.18.1 (49785), family 'delta-Endotoxin, C-terminal domain' (49796), species Bacillus thuringiensis tenebrionis CRYIIIA (BT13), TaxId 1444 (49798). Different folds means SCOPe 2.04 asserted no common ancestry whatsoever; the only shared node was class b, All beta proteins (48724), which carries no evolutionary claim.

In current SCOPe (2.08) the ColG CBD domain d1nqda_ (sunid 86025 preserved) is b.18.1.36, with lineage class b, fold b.18 Galactose-binding domain-like (49784), superfamily b.18.1 Galactose-binding domain-like (49785), family 'Collagen-binding domain' (sunid 267607), protein 'Class 1 collagenase' (267633), species Clostridium histolyticum (267693). The Cry3A domain d1dlca1 is unchanged at b.18.1.3. The old collagen-binding superfamily b.23.2 (sunid 89260) no longer resolves in 2.08; it returns HTTP 404 not_found. So the collagen-binding domain was lifted out of the CUB-like fold entirely and merged into the galactose-binding domain-like superfamily as a new, 36th family alongside the delta-endotoxin C-terminal family. The b.23 CUB-like fold itself still exists in 2.08, but no longer holds the ColG CBD.

The net relationship change is: unrelated folds in 2.04, same superfamily and different families in 2.08. A deterministic lineage comparison of d1nqda_ against d1dlca1 in 2.08 returns relationship 'same_superfamily' with lowest shared node sunid 49785 (b.18.1), interpreted as consistent with probable common ancestry, and reports caveats_present false for both domains. This is the strongest evolutionary statement SCOPe makes short of family membership: probable, structure-inferred common ancestry despite negligible sequence similarity and different function.

Note also a parsing change in the same interval. SCOPe 2.04 defined two whole-chain domains for 1nqd, d1nqda_ and d1nqdb_ (sunids 86025, 86026). SCOPe 2.08 keeps d1nqda_ for chain A but splits chain B into d1nqdb1 (B:893-1008, b.18.1.36, sunid 86026) and d1nqdb2 (B:891-892, sunid 281794) in class l.1.1.1, the artifacts class.
